info.name: NomNom Food Ordering Platform
info.description: API test collection cho NomNom. Auth (register/login) va cac request goi qua gateway ({{gatewayUrl}}) dung {{accessToken}}. Cac service con lai hien chua co JWT filter rieng nen duoc goi truc tiep toi tung service (vd {{restaurantServiceUrl}}) va tu set header X-User-Id / X-User-Role (binh thuong do API Gateway inject sau khi validate JWT).
